# Cross-language golden vectors for the diagnostic-log containers `VDLG`
# (ring files on flash and on the SD card) and `VDLW` (one message on the
# bus). One `key=hexbytes` per line.
#
# Generated from the Python reference implementation
# (python/visio_schema/mcap/crypto.py). Both python/tests/
# test_recording_crypto.py and cpp/tests/test_recording_crypto.cc load these
# bytes and assert THEIR implementation reproduces them.
#
# THE KEY, NONCE AND PLAINTEXT ARE VREC'S, DELIBERATELY. Every input here is
# byte-identical to tests/golden/vrec_vectors.txt, so the only thing that
# differs is the CipherSuite. That makes these vectors a direct proof of the
# one property the suites exist for: the same key and nonce under a different
# label derive a different file key and produce unrelated ciphertext. If a
# refactor ever collapsed two labels into one, the file keys below would
# collide and these lines would stop matching.
#
# Why VDLW is a separate suite from VDLG rather than the same bytes on a
# different medium: both are keyed from the SAME fleet key, and the ring
# writer and the bus publisher are independent producers. Under one label
# they would draw from a single nonce space and would have to coordinate
# counters across two subsystems forever; nonce reuse under a stream cipher
# recovers both plaintexts from the two ciphertexts alone. Separate labels
# make them different keystreams by construction.
#
# The key and nonce are recognisable counting patterns. They are TEST values;
# the real diagnostic key is a fleet secret and never enters this repo.

# Shared with vrec_vectors.txt — see above.
diag_key=000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f
diag_nonce=404142434445464748494a4b
diag_key_fp=630dcd2966c43366

# VDLG: HMAC-SHA256(key, b'visio-diag-v1' + nonce)
vdlg_file_key=7b1dffb4e40ed6cd8604388909b78119d5aaf848af4aa52c99d9e478c791c629
vdlg_header=56444c4701010000630dcd2966c43366404142434445464748494a4b00000000
vdlg_

# VDLW: HMAC-SHA256(key, b'visio-diag-wire-v1' + nonce)
vdlw_file_key=91a4acdbdc675d7488b94778251fb0c2d2eb03892a0c652efcd6a26b748fbfcf
vdlw_header=56444c5701010000630dcd2966c43366404142434445464748494a4b00000000
vdlw_
